definitions.gloss: school closure, closing of a school; closed school
definitions.explanation: The permanent closing of a school, typically due to declining student numbers from depopulation. Also refers to the building of a school that has been closed.

examples.japanese: {少子化|しょうしか}で{廃校|はいこう}になる{学校|がっこう}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: The number of schools being closed due to the declining birthrate is increasing.

examples.japanese: {廃校|はいこう}をカフェに{改装|かいそう}した。
examples.english: They renovated a closed school into a café.

examples.japanese: {地域|ちいき}の{人口|じんこう}{減少|げんしょう}により{廃校|はいこう}が{相次|あいつ}ぎ、{跡地|あとち}の{活用|かつよう}が{課題|かだい}となっている。
examples.english: Due to the regional population decline, school closures have been occurring one after another, and utilization of the former sites has become an issue.

notes:
USAGE:
Used both as a noun ({廃校|はいこう}になる = to become a closed school) and with する ({廃校|はいこう}する = to close a school). In recent years, repurposing {廃校|はいこう} buildings as community centers, art spaces, hotels, or businesses has become a national trend in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {廃校|はいこう}になる: to be closed (a school)
- {廃校|はいこう}の{活用|かつよう}: repurposing of closed schools
- {廃校|はいこう}{跡|あと}: former school site
- {廃校|はいこう}{舎|しゃ}: closed school building
